run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T21:58:26Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: RequestErrorRate for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing because frontend-proxy's own ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR: 143.2 ingress and 94.5 egress error spans in the 20:58:26-22:19:38 window, with the 5-minute ingress error rate at 0.359/s at 22:03:26 and 22:05:26 and small non-zero readings (0.0037-0.0185/s) before and after. The access log shows the actual answers behind those spans: 500 (via_upstream) for POST /api/cart, GET /api/cart and POST /api/checkout between 22:01:00.371 and 22:01:28.343, and 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} from the frontend upstream at 21:57:13, 21:59:13, 22:02:13-22:03:19 and 22:05:32. The frontend's own ERROR spans are confined to 22:00-22:04 and are on its cart/checkout path (grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, plus tcp.connect), i.e. frontend could not complete cart calls. In the same minute the cart Deployment was rolled out by a restart of the pod template (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T22:00:56Z, image unchanged at ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart): replica set cart-84889c965d scaled 0->1 at 22:00:56, cart-755465879b scaled 1->0 at 22:00:59, old pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 stopped. A fault-injection setting is switched on in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config: flag cartFailure (description 'Fail cart service') has defaultVariant 'on'; every other fault flag read there is off. That flagd ConfigMap is mounted by the flagd Deployment and the cart service does evaluate flags at runtime (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean spans). However, cart itself emitted no ERROR spans in the whole window and its post-restart logs show normal successful GetCart/AddItem/EmptyCart calls, so the declared cart-side failure was not observed directly, and the 503 connection resets at 21:57:13/21:59:13 precede the cart restart. The alert's exact expression could not be read and its 0.0111 value could not be reproduced from the traces error ratio. Conclusion is partial: the frontend-proxy error signal and its cart/checkout origin are established, the flagd cartFailure setting and the cart restart are the leading candidates, but the flag change time and the cart-side fault itself are unverified.

claims.text: frontend-proxy produced STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the sampled window: span 'ingress' 143.20 and span 'router frontend egress' 94.45 over 20:58:26-22:19:38, against STATUS_CODE_UNSET values 22299.88 and 22352.89 for the same two spans.

frontend ERROR spans in the window are confined to the 180s evaluations ending 22:03:00 and 22:04:00 (i.e. roughly 22:00-22:04) and are on the cart/checkout path: increase 62.4 for grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, 27.6 for grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, 21.6 for grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 8.4 for tcp.connect, 62.4 for POST /api/cart, 27.6 for GET /api/cart and 21.6 for POST /api/checkout; all other sampled evaluations were 0.

frontend-proxy access log for 21:55:00-22:06:00 contains 500 via_upstream answers for POST /api/cart, GET /api/cart and POST /api/checkout from 22:01:00.371 to 22:01:28.343, plus 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' entries for /api/data?contextKeys=assembly at 21:57:13.251, /api/products/66VCHSJNUP at 21:59:13.245, /api/products/* at 22:02:13-22:02:14, /api/products/2ZYFJ3GM2N at 22:03:19.557 and /api/products/66VCHSJNUP at 22:05:32.894; the logged upstream for all of these is 'frontend'.

Deployment cart in namespace otel-demo carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T22:00:56Z, container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart, 1/1 ready; its two ReplicaSets cart-755465879b (replicas 0) and cart-84889c965d (ready 1) both use the same 2.1.3-cart image, i.e. the restart kept the image unchanged.

otel-demo events record the cart rollout: Deployment cart 'Scaled up replica set cart-84889c965d from 0 to 1' at 22:00:56Z, ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d 'Created pod: cart-84889c965d-tkxdz', Deployment cart 'Scaled down replica set cart-755465879b from 1 to 0' at 22:00:59Z, ReplicaSet cart-755465879b 'Deleted pod: cart-755465879b-rh5r4', and Pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 'Stopping container cart' at 22:00:59Z; the same namespace also records fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-v48vh container Started at 22:06:27Z after a restart.

ConfigMap flagd-config in namespace otel-demo holds demo.flagd.json in which flag 'cartFailure' has description 'Fail cart service', state ENABLED and defaultVariant 'on'; the other fault-like flags read in the same document (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) all have defaultVariant 'off'.
Deployment flagd mounts configMap flagd-config as volume 'config-ro' and keeps an emptyDir 'config-rw' mounted at /etc/flagd, so the cartFailure setting read above is the configuration flagd serves.

The cart service evaluates feature flags at runtime: its spans include flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean with increase 1171.65 and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream over 20:58:26-22:19:38.

The cart service shows no ERROR-status spans of its own in the window: the only cart series with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream with value 0, so the cart-side failure declared by the 'Fail cart service' flag was not observed in cart's own telemetry.

cart-84889c965d-tkxdz logs after the restart show normal successful traffic (GetCartAsync, AddItemAsync, EmptyCartAsync for many userIds at 22:09:55-22:09:59), and a filtered read of 21:55:00-22:15:00 returned only one line, a startup HTTP_PORTS message, with no application error line.

frontend ERROR spans include tcp.connect (8.4) and are limited to 22:00-22:04, the same minutes in which the single cart pod was replaced (stopped 22:00:59, new pod created 22:00:56, first cart log 22:01:21), which is consistent with a transient loss of the cart endpoint rather than application-level cart failures.

At query time all 21 otel-demo pods were Running and ready; cart-84889c965d-tkxdz started 22:00:56Z with restartCount 0, and fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-v48vh showed a previous instance terminated OOMKilled with exitCode 137 at 22:06:26Z and restartCount 1.

Service cart selects opentelemetry.io/name=cart on port 8080 and its endpoints currently resolve to pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz at 100.96.1.157:8080; Service frontend selects opentelemetry.io/name=frontend and resolves to frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 at 100.96.3.35:8080.

In this window the frontend-proxy request telemetry available in Prometheus is traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket; the full metric-name list returned for the window (63 names) contains no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count or app_payment_transactions_total series.

The alert's reported value could not be reproduced from these spans: at 21:58:26 the frontend-proxy ERROR/total span ratio was 0 over 5m, 0.000156 over 10m and 0.001497 over 30m, whereas the alert annotation states 0.011111.

Other services' error spans in the same window are small and not co-located with the frontend burst: recommendation carried about 1.05 error spans per 10 minutes in every sampled window from 21:43:26 to 22:18:26, while ad and fraud-detection each carried about 1.05 in the windows ending 21:58:26, 22:03:26, 22:08:26 and 22:13:26 and 0 in the others; cart, checkout, payment, accounting and currency read 0 in the windows where their series existed.

The switched-on flag cartFailure ('Fail cart service', defaultVariant 'on') in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config is the fault source: it targets the cart service, cart was restarted in place at 22:00:56Z with an unchanged image and its pod template marked restartedAt, and no other object was seen applying a change or fault to cart; the restart and the frontend cart/checkout errors at 22:00-22:04 would then be its mechanism and consequence.

Independently of the flag, replacing the single cart pod (old pod stopped 22:00:59Z, new container started 22:00:58Z but the application only logging from 22:01:21Z) briefly removed the only cart endpoint, which would explain the 500 burst on /api/cart and /api/checkout between 22:01:00.371 and 22:01:28.343 and the tcp.connect failures in the frontend.

The fraud-detection container OOMKill is not the cause of this alert: the frontend ERROR spans sit in 22:00-22:04 and the cart/checkout 500s at 22:01:00-22:01:28 precede the OOMKilled termination at 22:06:26Z.

A cart Service/endpoint selector mismatch is not supported as the cause of the refused connections: Service cart's selector opentelemetry.io/name=cart has a current endpoint 100.96.1.157:8080 pointing at pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz, and the frontend Service likewise resolves to frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8:8080.

Read the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule that defines RequestErrorRate (its expression, threshold and evaluation window) so the reported 0.0111 can be tied to a concrete metric; the rule is not exposed by the rules API here.

Use audit/change history (integration not available in this Run) to identify who set kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T22:00:56Z on Deployment cart and who changed cartFailure in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, and if cart failure is not intended switch that flag off and reload flagd.

Give cart more than one replica or a readiness-gated rolling update so replacing the single cart pod does not remove the only endpoint, and review the fraud-detection memory limit because its container was OOMKilled (exitCode 137).

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not exposed: list_prometheus_rules filtered by rule_name=RequestErrorRate and by type=alert both returned no rule data, so the alert expression, threshold and 'for' duration are unknown, and the annotated value 0.011111 could not be reproduced from the traces span ratios (0 at 5m, 0.000156 at 10m, 0.001497 at 30m at 21:58:26).

There is no change history integration in this Run, and the ConfigMap/Deployment objects were read only in their current state, so it cannot be determined when cartFailure was set to 'on' in flagd-config or who triggered the cart restart at 22:00:56Z.

The declared cart fault was not observed inside the cart service: cart produced no ERROR spans and its post-restart logs show successful calls, so whether the cartFailure flag was actually in effect during 22:00-22:04 is unverified.

Jaeger returned no traces at all for the frontend or frontend-proxy service in every window tried (21:56-22:08, 22:05-22:19, 22:10-22:19), so span-level error text and parent-child call edges for the failing requests are unknown.
The frontend container log read for 21:57:00-22:06:00 returned zero lines, so the internal reason the frontend answered 500 on /api/cart and /api/checkout is unknown.
The previous cart pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 no longer exists, so its logs for 22:00:56-22:01:00 are unavailable.

Metric series for cart and frontend start partway through the window (frontend error series from about 21:48, cart error series only from the 22:03:26 evaluation), so the absence of cart ERROR spans around the restart is not fully established.
The 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses at 21:57:13 and 21:59:13 precede the cart restart and are not explained by the cart evidence gathered.

Queries for resourcequotas and networkpolicies in otel-demo returned no objects; an empty result does not prove those objects are absent, and the flagd pod logs returned no lines, so flag evaluation during the incident could not be inspected.
